## What's Changed
* 降低漫画阅读时的图片与同步开销 by @intitni in https://github.com/intitni/Willow/pull/18
* 让漫画围绕触点缩放并支持同时平移 by @intitni in https://github.com/intitni/Willow/pull/19
* 准备 Willow 1.2.1 版本 by @intitni in https://github.com/intitni/Willow/pull/20


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/intitni/Willow/compare/version/1.2.0...version/1.2.1

附件含未签名 IPA、MPL-2.0 对应源码和 SHA-256 校验文件。[安装与许可说明](https://github.com/intitni/Willow/blob/version/1.2.1/README.md)
